name: imdtrack
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "imdtrack" %}
{% set version = "0.2.8" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 4c8fbb7870a2454d60e60a5a142589449718a51f466068bd0fdb0fd3cbdab2a3

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  entry_points:
    - imdtrack = imdtrack.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - hatchling
    - hatch-vcs
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - pandas >=1.5
    - pyarrow >=10.0

test:
  imports:
    - imdtrack
  commands:
    - imdtrack --help
    - pip check
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip

about:
  home: https://github.com/syedhamidali/imdtrack
  summary: IMD RSMC New Delhi North Indian Ocean cyclone best-track data as pandas / xarray
  description: |
    imdtrack serves the India Meteorological Department (RSMC New Delhi) cyclone
    best-track record as tidy pandas DataFrames and CF-style xarray Datasets,
    kept up to date automatically by a validated monthly pipeline. Optional
    extras add xarray output ([xarray]), cartopy map plotting ([plot]), and the
    workbook-parsing pipeline ([pipeline]).
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  doc_url: https://imdtrack.readthedocs.io/
  dev_url: https://github.com/syedhamidali/imdtrack

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - syedhamidali
